# FrameFlow — AI Product Photography
> Turn smartphone photos into studio-quality product images in 30 seconds.

## What is FrameFlow?
FrameFlow is an AI-powered product photography tool for e-commerce sellers. It transforms simple smartphone photos into professional studio-quality images with white backgrounds, lifestyle scenes, and 4K resolution. Designed for Amazon, Shopify, and marketplace sellers who need cost-effective product photography.

## Key Features
- AI background removal with realistic drop shadows
- Amazon-compliant pure white backgrounds
- AI-generated lifestyle scenes
- 4K resolution export
- Batch processing for large catalogs
- Starting from 0.20 EUR per photo

## Pricing Plans
- Free Trial: 3 free photos to test
- Starter: 35 photos/month
- Pro: 90 photos/month
- Business: 210 photos/month

## Target Users
- Amazon FBA sellers
- Shopify store owners
- E-commerce brands
- Product photographers
- Marketing agencies

## Technical Details
- Web application (no download needed)
- Works with any smartphone photo
- AI-powered by state-of-the-art models
- Supabase backend for secure storage
- Available at: https://frameflow.design

- Website: https://frameflow.design
